# Corel Discovery Center

> Comprehensive learning hub for Corel's creative software suite including photo editing, video production, graphics design, and digital painting tools.

Corel Discovery Center provides tutorials, project templates, free resources, and community engagement for users of PaintShop Pro, CorelDRAW, VideoStudio, Pinnacle Studio, and Painter. The platform serves both beginners and advanced users with step-by-step guides, video tutorials, and creative challenges.

## Key Topics

- PaintShop Pro
- CorelDRAW
- VideoStudio
- Pinnacle Studio
- Painter
- Photo editing
- Video editing
- Vector graphics
- Digital painting
- PHOTO-PAINT
- Vision FX 2.0
- Tutorials
- Free trials
- Creative templates
- Community galleries

## Product Learning Centers

- [Home - Corel Discovery Center](https://learn.corel.com): Main hub for Corel learning resources covering photo, video, graphics, and painting tools
- [Photo home - Corel Discovery Center](https://learn.corel.com/photo-home): PaintShop Pro photo editing learning center with tutorials and Vision FX 2.0
- [Video Home - Corel Discovery Center](https://learn.corel.com/video-home): VideoStudio and Pinnacle Studio video editing learning hub with featured tutorials
- [Graphics Home - Corel Discovery Center](https://learn.corel.com/graphics-home): CorelDRAW and PHOTO-PAINT graphics design learning center with design tutorials
- [Painting Home - Corel Discovery Center](https://learn.corel.com/painting-home): Painter digital painting learning hub with brush packs and illustration tutorials

## Tutorial Libraries

- [Photo Tutorials - Corel Discovery Center](https://learn.corel.com/photo-tutorials): PaintShop Pro photo editing tutorials covering HDR and raw photo techniques
- [Video Tutorials - Corel Discovery Center](https://learn.corel.com/video-tutorials): VideoStudio and Pinnacle Studio video editing tutorial catalog with techniques
- [Graphics Tutorials - Corel Discovery Center](https://learn.corel.com/graphics-tutorials): CorelDRAW and PHOTO-PAINT vector and image editing tutorial library
- [Painting Tutorials - Corel Discovery Center](https://learn.corel.com/painting-tutorials): Painter digital art tutorials covering illustration and concept art techniques
- [WordPerfect Office Tutorials - Corel Discovery Center](https://learn.corel.com/wordperfect-office-tutorials): WordPerfect Office productivity software tutorials with shortcuts and formatting

## Community & Resources

- [Join our Community - Corel Discovery Center](https://learn.corel.com/community): Community hub with forums, galleries, challenges, and user engagement
- [Free Trials - Corel Discovery Center](https://learn.corel.com/free-trials): Free trial downloads for CorelDRAW, VideoStudio, Pinnacle Studio, PaintShop Pro
- [Free Stuff - Corel Discovery Center](https://learn.corel.com/free-stuff): Free trials, manuals, webinars, and creative resources for Corel products
- [Freebies - Corel Discovery Center](https://learn.corel.com/freebies): Weekly free downloads including scripts, templates, and motion graphics
- [Blog - Corel Discovery Center](https://learn.corel.com/blog): Blog featuring design resources, free downloads, and product tutorials

## Projects & Support

- [Projects - Corel Discovery Center](https://learn.corel.com/projects): DIY craft and home decoration projects with free templates and tutorials
- [Questions - Corel Discovery Center](https://learn.corel.com/how-to/questions): FAQ and Q&A help center for CorelDRAW, PaintShop Pro, and VideoStudio

## Optional

- [Contests - Corel Discovery Center](https://learn.corel.com/contest): Creative contests and user galleries showcasing community artwork
